children: China's central bank extended its gold-buying streak to a 22nd consecutive month in August, increasing its holdings to 76.73 million fine troy ounces from 76.08 million at the end of July.
The value of China's gold reserves rose to $350.08 billion at the end of August from $306.35 billion a month earlier, according to data from the People's Bank of China on Monday.
